articles.detail: 6 cycles, all completed, avg 10 published/cycle (61 yesterday)

experiment: Skipped. No experiments are active and there is no pause gate. Every target is met except Latin American datelines: 4% today against a 5% floor, after 5% yesterday. One day just under the floor is not enough to act on, and the only lever for it, GAP_COUNTRIES, was tried on 2026-09-18 and reverted.
weakestArea: Latin American datelines are 4% against a 5% floor. Today's three are Marcovia (Honduras), Guasave (Mexico) and Port-au-Prince (Haiti). US datelines fell from 35% to exactly the 25% cap, though three of the 13 still carry the bare place name "United States". Multi-source rose to 38%, the best reading in recent audits.
watching: The Hormuz crisis: Iran calls the blockade an act of war, claims strikes on tankers and a downed F-16 that CENTCOM denies, oil shipments are falling, and Qatar is hosting talks.
The Houthis fired missiles at Riyadh for a third night.
Poland calls two Russian missiles a provocation, while drones hit a cargo ship from Kaliningrad in the Gulf of Finland.
Chip stocks crashed on an SEC accounting probe into Nvidia, deepening the AI-led selloff across Nasdaq, TSMC and ASML.
COP31 in Antalya went into overtime, deadlocked on fossil-fuel finance.
El Chapo's son Isidro was captured after a gunfight in Sinaloa, and Salvadoran soldiers were killed in Haiti.
coverageGaps: No Oceania dateline today, and one yesterday (Sydney).
Asia had only 5 datelines, down from 10, and four of those were Indian; there was no Southeast Asia and only one China dateline (Shenzhen).

Some placeless stories get datelines that do not fit them: the Ars Technica race-science piece is datelined Davos, and several others carry only a country name (Sweden, Germany, Japan, Denmark, United States).
context: Six cycles ran today against the usual five, all completed, with an average of 919s, down from 1037s. The writer quarantined one article (araghchi-us-peace-agreement-iran-war.md.bad). Only one story rests on state or advocacy outlets alone (France protests). Pick the dateline problem up in the writer's dateline rule, not with a tuning parameter.
